C.domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers, including common denominators, unlike denominators, borrowing, normalization, and simplification

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when denominators do not already match.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when a step converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions with a shared denominator.
Tag for mixed-number items if only the fractional parts are being rewritten to a common denominator.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag mere subtraction of fractions after a common denominator has already been established.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as a mixed number with 0 over a denominator unless it is part of denominator matching.

skills.name: Normalize mixed form
skills.definition: Rewrite a nonstandard mixed number or whole number into a subtraction-ready form, such as converting an improper fractional part to a standard mixed number or expressing a whole number as a whole plus 0 over a denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized to a standard mixed number.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over a denominator to align with mixed-number subtraction.
Tag when the rewrite prepares the quantities for later whole-part and fraction-part subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag conversion to equivalent fractions for unlike denominators; that is common-denominator work.
Do not tag borrowing from the whole part during subtraction.
Do not tag final recombination of whole and fractional parts.

skills.name: Subtract fraction parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractional quantities once they are in compatible form, including simple fraction subtraction or the fractional part of mixed-number subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a common denominator.
Tag when fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted.
Tag whether the fractional result is positive, zero, or initially negative before borrowing is resolved.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag finding or creating a common denominator.
Do not tag subtracting whole-number parts only.
Do not tag simplification of the resulting fraction after subtraction.

skills.name: Subtract whole parts
skills.definition: Subtract the whole-number components in a mixed-number or whole-number subtraction setup.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly subtracts whole parts such as 4 − 2 = 2.
Tag when the whole part is retained or adjusted as part of mixed-number subtraction.
Tag for items involving whole numbers, mixed numbers, or a whole part created by normalization.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag subtraction of fractional parts.
Do not tag borrowing itself; borrowing is a separate regrouping action.
Do not tag final combination into a mixed number unless the step explicitly performs whole-part subtraction.

skills.name: Borrow across mixed number
skills.definition: Regroup one whole into fractional units when the fractional part of the minuend is too small to subtract the fractional part of the subtrahend.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step borrows 1 from the whole part and converts it into denominator-sized fractional units.
Tag when the whole part is reduced and the fractional part is increased to continue subtraction.
Tag whether the borrowing occurs after an initial negative fraction result or is written directly as regrouping.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction when no regrouping is needed.
Do not tag normalization of improper mixed numbers before subtraction.
Do not tag simplification after subtraction.

skills.name: Simplify and combine
skills.definition: Reduce the result to lowest terms and express it in an appropriate final form such as a fraction, mixed number, whole number, or zero.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is simplified to lowest terms.
Tag when whole and fractional results are combined into a final mixed number or integer.
Tag when a zero fraction is rewritten as 0 or when a mixed-number result collapses to a whole number.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the earlier subtraction steps that produce the unsimplified result.
Do not tag normalization or borrowing steps.
Do not tag common-denominator conversion.

B.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Normalize mixed form
skills.definition: Rewrite a mixed number that has an improper fractional part as an equivalent standard mixed number before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly converts a form like 2 3/2 or 1 4/3 into a standard mixed number.
Tag when the solver states 'normalize' or rewrites an improper fraction part into extra whole units plus a proper fraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for rewriting a whole number as a whole plus 0/n.
Do not tag for finding common denominators or equivalent fractions.
Do not tag when the mixed number already has a proper fractional part and is used as-is.

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite one or both fractions as equivalent fractions with that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step finds an LCD or common denominator for unlike denominators.
Tag when fractions are converted to equivalent fractions such as 5/3 to 20/12.
Tag even if the common denominator equals an existing denominator and one fraction stays unchanged.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag for borrowing from a whole to create n/n.
Do not tag for simplification after subtraction.

skills.name: Rewrite whole as fraction
skills.definition: Express a whole number as a whole plus a zero-fraction with the needed denominator so it can be combined with fractional subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as something like 3 + 0/5 or 2 + 0/8.
Tag when this rewrite is used to align a whole number with a mixed number or fraction in subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for normalizing an improper mixed number.
Do not tag for borrowing 1 whole into n/n after subtraction has begun.
Do not tag when whole and fraction parts are simply subtracted without introducing 0/n.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a shared denominator and/or subtract the whole-number parts once the quantities are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a common denominator.
Tag when whole parts and fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted directly.
Tag when a fraction part is subtracted from 0/n or from another same-denominator fraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for the prior step of creating equivalent fractions.
Do not tag for borrowing/regrouping after a negative fractional result appears.
Do not tag for final simplification or recombination into the answer form.

skills.name: Borrow across whole
skills.definition: Regroup by taking 1 from the whole-number part and converting it to a full fraction unit when the fractional subtraction would otherwise be negative.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly says 'borrow' or 'borrow 1 from the whole part.'
Tag when 1 whole is converted to n/n and added to the minuend fraction part before subtracting.
Tag when the solver adjusts the whole part downward and the fraction part upward to continue subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when subtraction is completed without regrouping.
Do not tag for rewriting a whole as 0/n before any need to borrow is identified.
Do not tag for simplification after the regrouped subtraction is done.

skills.name: Simplify and combine
skills.definition: Reduce the result to lowest terms and express it in final integer, fraction, or mixed-number form by combining whole and fractional parts as needed.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is simplified, such as 2/10 to 1/5 or 9/12 to 3/4.
Tag when 0/3 is rewritten as 0 or when a zero fractional part is dropped from a mixed-number result.
Tag when separate whole and fraction results are combined into a final mixed number or single fraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for the subtraction step itself before any final-form rewriting.
Do not tag for finding common denominators or borrowing.
Do not tag for classification statements like 'Type C' or 'Type E.'

A.domain: Subtraction of fractions and mixed numbers with simplification

skills.name: Normalize given form
skills.definition: Rewrite a number into a usable equivalent form before subtracting, such as converting a mixed number with an improper fractional part to a standard mixed number or writing a whole number as a whole plus a fractional part with denominator 0/d.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly rewrites a mixed number with an improper fraction part, e.g. 2 3/2 to 3 1/2.
Tag when a step rewrites a whole number as a whole plus 0/d to align with fraction subtraction, e.g. 3 to 3 + 0/5.
Tag when the rewrite is done to prepare later subtraction of whole and fractional parts.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when the step only finds a common denominator for existing fractions.
Do not tag when the step only borrows 1 from the whole part during subtraction.
Do not tag when the step only combines already computed whole and fractional results.

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and convert one or both fractions to equivalent fractions with that denominator before subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when a step converts fractions such as 5/3 to 20/12 or 3/5 to 6/10.
Tag even if the common denominator equals the original denominator and the fractions stay numerically the same, as long as the step explicitly performs that setup.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion step is shown.
Do not tag when the step only subtracts numerators after denominators already match.
Do not tag when the step only simplifies the final result.

skills.name: Subtract aligned fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractional parts once they share a denominator, including simple same-denominator fraction subtraction and fraction-part subtraction inside mixed-number problems.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step subtracts numerators over a common denominator, such as 20/12 minus 9/12 or 6/7 minus 4/7.
Tag when a step subtracts the fractional parts of mixed numbers after any needed setup.
Tag whether the fractional result is positive, zero, or negative.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when the step is only finding the common denominator or converting fractions.
Do not tag when the step is only subtracting whole-number parts.
Do not tag when the step is only simplifying a fraction after subtraction.

skills.name: Subtract whole parts
skills.definition: Subtract the whole-number components in a mixed-number or whole-number subtraction problem.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly computes the whole-part difference, such as 4 minus 3 equals 1.
Tag when a whole number is compared with the whole part of a mixed number.
Tag even if the whole-part result is later adjusted by borrowing.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for pure fraction items with no whole-number component.
Do not tag when the step only rewrites a whole number as a whole plus 0/d.
Do not tag when the step only combines the final whole and fractional results into one answer.

skills.name: Borrow across mixed number
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as denominator/denominator and add it to the fractional part when the fractional subtraction would otherwise be negative.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly borrows 1 from the whole part.
Tag when the borrowed whole is rewritten as d/d and added to the existing fractional part, such as 12/12 + 4/12.
Tag when borrowing resolves a negative fractional difference in a mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction problem.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when no regrouping is needed because the fractional part subtracts directly.
Do not tag when a step only normalizes an improper mixed number before subtraction.
Do not tag when the step only simplifies the final fraction.

skills.name: Simplify and compose result
skills.definition: Reduce the computed result to lowest terms and express it in an appropriate final form such as a fraction, mixed number, whole number, or zero.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step simplifies a fraction, such as 2/10 to 1/5 or 9/12 to 3/4.
Tag when a step converts 0/d to 0 or combines whole and fractional parts into the final mixed number or integer.
Tag when the final answer form is explicitly assembled from previously computed parts.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when the step only subtracts fractions or whole parts without final formatting.
Do not tag when the step only finds a common denominator.
Do not tag when the step only borrows from the whole part.
